verdict.rationale: Deel's API and MCP server expose payroll, contracts, and people data that an agent could pull (deel-docs-2, deel-docs-8, deel-docs-18, deel-docs-23), and webhooks/API sandbox support building integrations (deel-docs-6, deel-docs-3).
